Messages.Author: Raven
Messages.Body:
Hello,

Let's say vampire has The Rack targeted at her.
Then she goes to torpor and other player plays Graverobbing at her and takes control.

How The Rack works from this moment? Does it give blood to targeted vampire regardless of player who controls vampire?

Similar situation but this vampire is Capuchin. Capuchin is somehow burned.
What happens then? Does he uses his ability and returns under the control of his owner or stays under the control of recent controller in uncontrolled region?

Messages.Author: Yomyael
Messages.Body:
Ahoi,

first: you should post relevant card text along with the rules question, it makes it a lot easier to just look at the question and answer it, instead of first searching for the card text.

Rack

Name: The Rack
[Jyhad:U, VTES:U, CE:U, Third:U, KoT:U/PT, SP:DoF1]
Cardtype: Master
Unique location.
As this card is played or the controller of this card changes, the controller chooses a ready vampire they control. During the controller's unlock phase, the chosen vampire can gain 2 blood. A vampire controlled by another Methuselah can steal this location as a  action.
Artist: Quinton Hoover; Steve Prescott

For the first question, I'm not 100% sure if this answer is correct. The card text references "the controller", from context I deduce it is the controller of the rack. So it would happen during the unlock phase. It sais "the vampire can gain 2 blood". The question in my opinion boils down to: who chooses if this can effect is used? I'd say the controller of the Rack chooses. Therefore the vampire would gain 2 blood, no matter who controls the vampire, if the controller of he rack chooses it to be so.

Capuchin

Name: The Capuchin
[Promo-20150219, Promo-20181004:HB2, Promo-20190804]
Cardtype: Vampire
Clan: Harbinger of Skulls
Group: 5
Capacity: 11
Discipline: AUS DOM FOR NEC THA THN
Independent: If The Capuchin is burned, move him to your uncontrolled region and you get +3 transfers at the start of your next influence phase. +1 bleed. +2 hand size. +1 intercept.
Artist: Ginés Quiñonero

For the second question: Again, not 100% sure, but I assume that a vampire cannot move to the uncontrolled region of a player who is not the owner of the card (same as Ash Heap, Library, etc.). But if this implies the Capuchin is moved to his owners uncontrolled or is simply burned, I do not know.

Prince of Bonn, Germany

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> Raven wrote:
> Let's say vampire has The Rack targeted at her.
> Then she goes to torpor and other player plays Graverobbing at her and takes control.
>
> How The Rack works from this moment? Does it give blood to targeted vampire regardless of player who controls vampire?
>
A controls the Rack. B controls the vampire chosen by the Rack.
During A's unlock phase, B can choose to add 2 blood the chosen vampire, because the Rack reads "the chosen vampire can", not "you can" or "the controller of the Rack".

> Raven wrote:
> Similar situation but this vampire is Capuchin. Capuchin is somehow burned.
> What happens then? Does he uses his ability and returns under the control of his owner or stays under the control of recent controller in uncontrolled region?
>
If B was controlling the Capuchin when it burned, the Capuchin goes to B's uncontrolled region.

REVERSAL : The Capuchin goes to his owner's uncontrolled region. See www.vekn.net/forum/rules-questions/78568-the-capuchin-burns-temporary-control?start=12#99616

Prince of Paris, France

If I take control over vampire until my next untap phase using Malkavian Dementia.

Malkavian Dementia
Master.
You control a ready Malkavian that another Methuselah controls until your next untap phase.

And before my next untap phase owner of this vampire is ousted, what will happen with this vampire in my next untap phase?

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> Raven wrote:
> And before my next untap phase owner of this vampire is ousted, what will happen with this vampire in my next untap phase?
>
You return the vampire to their previous controller, and since that player has been ousted, the vampire is removed from the game.
